reproduction.method: Actual MCP stdio server against isolated mock bridges; final regression suite run against an unmodified baseline checkout.
failedBaselineChecks: response limit counts JSON escaping bytes
hard limit reports missing results as an MCP error without repeating the command
soft-limit warning preserves the last text block as the tool result
a soft-limit warning cannot push an otherwise valid result over the hard limit
image blocks and metadata overhead count toward the response limit
oversized failures retain bounded error details and recovery identifiers
an invalid hard-limit setting cannot disable the default protection
an image tool reporting no image is an MCP error
logical errors in image metadata retain the MCP error flag
oversized unknown-tool errors are bounded before dispatch
oversized project resources fail explicitly while smaller reads remain intact
core capture proxies retain image blocks and pass future parameters unchanged

behavior.accounting: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify(result), including content, metadata and escaping
behavior.excluded: JSON-RPC envelope, request ID and transport newline

limitations: Post-serialization output budget; does not bound upstream Unity allocations, HTTP downloads or peak serialization memory.
Recovery fields are retained only when they fit; omission of a response does not undo or establish success of an operation.
New budgets cover tools/call and resources/read; tools/list and resources/list remain outside this change.
Live Scene capture tested; Game capture proxy parity is covered by the isolated regression.
Client cancellation is unchanged; older-editor runtime validation remains deferred.
